title: Unraid
description: Self-hosted Unraid server: stats, Docker containers, parity, VMs, shares. Surface via iappyx.plugin('unraid').*. Pure local-network — no cloud. Requires Unraid 7.0+ (the official GraphQL API) and a server-side API key. Defaults to trusted-Wi-Fi-only so the key never leaves the device on a hostile network.
author: iappyx
